pages.title: Fractal Ore
pages.text: A vein that never resolves. Zoom in on any facet and it repeats itself in smaller copies, edges crinkling like a coastline whose length depends on the ruler you use. It has a fractional dimension somewhere between surface and solid, and it feels faintly rough no matter how finely it is polished.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Chipping at the axiom stone, I hit a seam whose outline kept getting longer the closer I measured it. Self-similarity that deep is not geology; it is a rule being iterated by the rock itself.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Platonic Realm (mine it for its drop).
